title: Wings — Inboard Flap Track No. 2 — Installation of the Reinforced Rib and Redistributed Bolt Pattern

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Installation of the thicker flap support rib, the renewed spar fitting and the five-bolt attachment pattern on aircraft delivered before the production cut-in, tripling the inspection interval and deleting the mirror check.

sections.planning_reason: Aircraft delivered before the production cut-in carry the original three-bolt attachment for the inboard flap track number two rib, which achieves too little clamp-up to prevent fretting under the reversing flap load. Operators of high-utilisation aircraft are repeating the eddy current inspection every 6000 flight cycles and are escalating to a rear spar boom repair in roughly one case in ten. This bulletin brings the aircraft to the reinforced standard and moves the inspection to a three times longer interval.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the flap support rib with a thicker item, renews the spar interface fitting with a redistributed five-bolt pattern, adds an upper cleat to close the load path into the spar web and changes the barrel nuts to a longer grip. Faying surfaces receive a solid-film lubricant that removes the fretting mechanism.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Do the inspection of Service Bulletin ZPH-57-1039 first and confirm that the attachment is serviceable. Extend and support the flaps and open the trailing edge access panels in zones 525 and 624. Remove the existing rib and the spar fitting. Drill the two additional holes using the jig supplied and do an eddy current inspection of each new hole. Apply the solid-film lubricant to the faying surfaces of the fitting D5730121797468 and the rib D5730125554505. Install the rib, the fitting and the upper cleat GIR438406-76 and fasten with the barrel nuts AGS934342-5A to the torque values of drawing D57301146439. Re-install the flap track and set the rigging. Close the access panels and do the flap operational test and the asymmetry check. Record the embodiment and update the inspection programme to the extended interval.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft in the MSN range Z01080 to Z09673 that are not yet at the reinforced standard, and only after the eddy current inspection of Service Bulletin ZPH-57-1039 has been done at the same visit with a serviceable result.
sections.material_note: Kit K5730-1042-01 contains the rib, the fitting, the cleat, the barrel nut set and the solid-film lubricant for one wing. Two kits are required per aircraft. Lead time is eighteen weeks. Removed ribs are not returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, and in any case before the third repetition of the inspection required by Service Bulletin ZPH-57-1039.

tooling: Eddy current bolt hole probe, 4 mm
